💌 THODA LAMBA HAI, PAR DIL SE

Ek proper sa letter

Dear Saba, 💗

Sabse pehle toh ek baar nahi, properly bolta hoon — HAPPY BIRTHDAYYY! 🎂🥳

Pata nahi birthday wish ko kitna bada hona chahiye, lekin mujhe laga ki sirf “happy birthday, enjoy your day” likh ke kaam khatam karna thoda boring hoga. Isliye socha ek poori website hi bana dete hain. 😂

Waise ye website dekhne mein jitni simple aur cute lag rahi hai, banate waqt utni simple nahi thi. Lekin birthday pe kisi ke liye kuch banana ho aur uske face pe thodi si smile aa jaye, toh mehnat ka hisaab kaun rakhta hai.

Friendship ki sabse achhi cheez ye hai ki har waqt perfect conversation zaroori nahi hoti. Kabhi random baatein hoti hain, kabhi hasi-mazaak, kabhi bas ek normal sa “kya kar rahi?” aur kabhi kuch bhi nahi. Phir bhi kuch log important lagte rehte hain. Ye importance kisi ek moment ki wajah se nahi hoti; dheere-dheere banti hai.

Bas meri wish ye hai ki aane wale saal mein tere paas bohot saare aise moments aaye jahan tu genuinely khush ho. Aise log mile jo teri respect karein, tere efforts samjhein, aur tujhe unnecessarily change karne ki koshish na karein.

Jo cheezein tu achieve karna chahti hai, unke liye patience mile. Jab kuch plan ke according na ho, tab bhi hope bani rahe. Aur jab kuch achha ho, tab us moment ko properly enjoy karna bhi na bhoolna.

Aur please ek cheez kabhi mat sochna ki tujhe har waqt perfect rehna hai. Perfect koi nahi hota. Kabhi lazy day, kabhi stupid joke, kabhi random mood, kabhi bina reason hansi — ye sab bhi life ka part hai. 😂

Aaj ka din bas birthday ke naam. No unnecessary tension. No overthinking. Cake, smile, thoda drama, thodi masti aur bohot saari achhi memories. 🎂✨

Aur haan, agar kabhi future mein ye website dobara kholegi, toh shayad tu sochegi ki “ye banda itna sab likh kaise gaya?” 😂 Bas samajh lena us din birthday wali energy kuch zyada hi thi.

Last mein bas itna — apni individuality ko maintain rakhna. Jo cheez tujhe genuinely khush karti hai, uske liye time nikalna. Aur life kitni bhi busy ho, kabhi-kabhi ruk kar ye bhi dekhna ki kitna aage aa gayi hai.

Happy Birthday once again, Saba. 🎂💗
May this year bring you peace, happiness, good people, good memories and plenty of reasons to smile.

“Kuch logon ke liye wishes likhi jaati hain,
aur kuch logon ke liye wishes thodi der soch kar likhni padti hain.”

Bas tu samajh gayi toh kaafi hai. 😂💗

🌟 12 BIRTHDAY WISHES

Tere liye 12 wishes

🎯 1. Jo goal hai, uske aur close ja.
🌸 2. Chhoti khushiyon ko bhi notice kar.
🫶 3. Genuine log tere aas-paas bane rahein.
📚 4. Jo seekhna chahe, usmein confidence badhe.
😂 5. Hasi ke reasons kabhi kam na ho.
🌙 6. Difficult days bhi manageable lagein.
✨ 7. Teri mehnat ka result tujhe khud proud feel karaye.
🎁 8. Unexpectedly achhi cheezein milti rahein.
☀️ 9. Har saal kuch naya dekhne aur seekhne ko mile.
💗 10. Apne liye bhi utna hi kind reh jitna dusron ke liye.
🎂 11. Birthday cakes kabhi boring na ho.
🚀 12. Aur sabse important — apni story khud likhti reh.
